Sie entwickeln und konfigurieren Simulationsnetzwerke sowie Hard- und Softwarekomponenten für Simulations- und Ausbildungssysteme
Als Softwareentwickler programmieren und erweitern Sie Simulationssoftware in C++ und Qt unter Linux und Windows

Description
Automat-it is an all-in AWS Premier Partner and Managed Services Provider specializing in the startup ecosystem. With over 800 customers and 500+ AWS certifications, Automat-it brings hands-on expertise in AI, DevOps, and FinOps to empower fast-paced startups to grow, deliver & win. Our customers save significant time-to-market and optimize their cloud performance and costs.
We work across EMEA and the US, fueling innovation and solving complex challenges daily. Join us to grow your skills, shape bold ideas, and help build the future of tech.
We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to join our dynamic R&D Team, where you will own high-scale features end-to-end across our FinOps platform and AWS billing engine — contributing directly to our mission of empowering fast-paced startups.
This is not a traditional coding role. You will generate the vast majority of your production code with AI, and your value comes from the deep technical judgment you apply on top of it: guiding the model, critiquing its output, and shipping solutions that are high-quality, maintainable, and future-proof. We're looking for a senior engineer who is excited that the craft of software is changing - and wants to operate at the frontier of it.
You will work with: Node.js/TypeScript (NestJS, Fastify, Prisma ORM) + React (TanStack, TipTap, Material UI, Untitled UI) + PostgreSQL.
Work location - Remote Ukraine

Own features end-to-end — from vague stakeholder ask to production deployment, including discovery, design, implementation, testing, rollout, and iteration.
Refine requirements proactively using the Value, Usability, Feasibility, Viability (VUFV) framework. Push back on weak requirements, propose better solutions than the one originally requested, and keep a tight feedback loop with stakeholders.
Generate your code with AI (We provide Claude Opus 4.7 in Cursor). Your job is to direct the model, review its output with a senior engineer's eye, and take full ownership of what ships — including architecture, performance, security, and long-term maintainability.
Continuously level up your AI workflow. Stay current with new models, tools, and techniques, and bring the best of them into the team.
Solve deep technical problems across FinOps processes and AWS billing calculations.
Write scalable, maintainable, well-tested, and well-documented code. Create and maintain system design and implementation docs.
Implement and support unit tests as a first-class part of delivery.

5+ years of experience as a Full Stack Developer shipping production systems.
Deep expertise in the TypeScript full-stack ecosystem — specifically NestJS and React — and experience with microservices architectures.
Strong experience with Prisma ORM + PostgreSQL.
Proven ability to translate complex, ambiguous business requirements into concrete technical specs and actionable work — and to challenge requirements when there's a better solution.
AI-first mindset. You already default to AI for code generation, and you have the technical depth to guide it rather than be guided by it. You understand every line the model produces and can explain why it's the right (or wrong) solution. This is explicitly not a "prompt engineer" role — it's a senior engineering role where AI is the primary authoring tool.
Strong debugging skills and a serious approach to unit testing.
Excellent problem-solving skills and a bias toward action and unblocking.
Fluent written and verbal English.

Experience with vector databases.
Experience with monorepo tooling (Turborepo, Nx).
Familiarity with AWS services, especially AWS Cost Explorer and AWS Cognito.

Strapi Framework experience.

Strong SQL knowledge.

Experience with Fastify.

About CoLab At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner. CoLab is the AI platform for driving stronger engineering decisions.

Every design review in CoLab builds a knowledge repository of design feedback, decisions, and lessons learned - which AI agents draw from to flag issues on future designs before they compound. The more your team works in CoLab, the smarter it gets and the faster you arrive at the ideal design.

Companies like Ford, Komatsu, and Johnson Controls use CoLab to catch issues earlier, eliminate rework cycles, and bring products to market faster. Founded in St. John's, Newfoundland, CoLab has grown quickly from our first customer in 2019 to a rapidly scaling company.

We've recently been recognized on Deloitte's Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, and named a Canadian company to watch by The Globe and Mail and Financial Post. About the Role Modern engineering teams invest a significant amount of time and money on simulation.

Before anything gets built, teams need confidence that a design is going to work: structurally, thermally, aerodynamically, etc. Simulation is one of the main ways they build that confidence. But the way teams share and review simulation results to make decisions is still pretty broken.

Engineers are exporting videos, taking screenshots, dropping them into PowerPoint, and then trying to make decisions through email threads, meetings, or disconnected slide decks.

The actual decision-making ends up separated from the underlying simulation data, which means context gets lost, feedback is hard to trace, and important engineering knowledge disappears into the workflow. CoLab already helps engineering teams review CAD, capture feedback, and make better design decisions in one connected workspace.

Now we’re extending that same idea into simulation. The goal is simple: make simulation results collaborative, reviewable, and traceable in the same way CoLab does for CAD today. We’re starting a new product team focused on bringing simulation review into CoLab.

As one of the first engineers on that team, you’ll help define how simulation data gets ingested, visualized, discussed, and connected back to real engineering decisions.

There are a lot of interesting technical problems here: large datasets, high-performance visualization, viewer interactions, data pipelines, and user experiences that need to work for mechanical engineers doing critical product development work.

The first phase is about learning the product, the customers, and the review workflows we already support today. You’ll spend time embedded with our Engineering Reviews team, learning how engineers collaborate in CoLab, where the current product is strong, and where simulation creates a new set of problems we need to solve.

From there, you’ll help build the foundation for a new Simulation team - not just technically, but from a product perspective as well. We want to build something customers actually need and will use in their day-to-day work, and that requires a highly product oriented approach.

Our Ideal Candidate You're the kind of developer who wants to understand why a feature matters before deciding how to build it. You enjoy owning complex technical problems, but you also enjoy talking with product managers, designers, and customers to understand what success actually looks like.

You make thoughtful technical decisions independently and know when to bring others into the conversation. Experience working with simulation software is a significant advantage. Maybe you've worked with FEA, CFD, multiphysics simulations, scientific visualization, or engineering data platforms.

You understand the kinds of problems engineers are trying to solve. This is a good fit for someone who likes ambiguity, wants to work closely with our product and leadership teams, and cares about the connection between technical decisions and customer value.

You’ll have a meaningful role in shaping both the architecture and the user experience for a new capability that we think can become a major part of engineering review in CoLab. What You'll Do
Help design and build CoLab's next-generation simulation review capabilities.
Build services that ingest and process simulation data from industry-standard engineering software.
Develop high-performance visualization experiences capable of displaying large simulation datasets.
Partner closely with Product, Design, and customers to validate ideas before building them.
Spend time embedded with the Engineering Reviews team to develop deep product and customer understanding before transitioning onto the Simulation team.
Contribute to architectural decisions that will shape this product area for years to come.
Improve performance, scalability, and reliability as simulation capabilities grow.
Collaborate with engineers across the platform to ensure simulation becomes a seamless part of the broader CoLab experience.

* Eine vielseitige und umfassende SAP-Rolle mit viel Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten
* Eine moderne SAP-Landschaft (S4HANA, BTP, BDC, SAC, SuccessFactors) mit abwechslungsreichen Aufgaben und unterschiedlichen Schnittstellen

Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for data testing methodologies and AI-assisted compliance testing (including automated claims validation patterns and AI-supported regulated workflows), guiding cross-functional teams in implementing scalable, reliable quality practices.
Test Automation & Data Validation
Design and execute automated tests for Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) / Extract, Load, Transform (ELT) pipelines, Application Programming Interfaces (APIs), and batch processes, leveraging AI Coding Assistants to speed up test authoring and coverage analysis.
Validate data quality, transformations, and business rules across claims, eligibility, and accumulations workflows.
Develop fully scalable test automation solutions for Databricks-based and cloud data environments.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Delivery
Partner with Data Engineers, Product Owners, Business Analysts, and SMEs to align testing with business and regulatory requirements.
Integrate automated data quality checks into CI/CD pipelines in collaboration with DevOps teams.
Support root cause analysis for test defects generated during functional tests on the Data Engineering continuous delivery stream, performance bottlenecks, and production incidents, using AI-assisted log and pattern analysis to accelerate triage.
Compliance, Security & Continuous Improvement
Ensure adherence to HIPAA, PHI, PII, and security standards across all testing practices
Drive adoption of modern tools and frameworks for test automation, monitoring, and reporting in cloud-based environments, including AI Coding Assistants and agentic testing workflows
Continuously improve testing processes to enhance reliability, scalability, and delivery velocity.
Apply deep expertise in Pharmacy Benefits Management (PBM)/Healthcare domains, including Medicare Part D, CMS compliance testing, and E-prescription (NCPDP SCRIPT) claims adjudication, to ensure automated tests reflect real-world regulatory and business rules.

Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, or a related field (in lieu of a bachelor’s degree, 10+ years of related work experience is needed)
8+ years of experience in Quality Engineering and Test Automation, with at least 5 years serving as a technical leader for other Quality Engineers / SDETs (required).

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer at Fueled , you will architect, build, and scale high-performance web applications from the database layer through to the browser.

Within Digital Product , your work may center around complex web applications, stateful front-end systems, API and backend architecture, real-time functionality, and end-to-end product feature development across web and mobile ecosystems.

Why should you consider joining Auvik?
You want to work at a company that is building impactful, relevant technology. Auvik’s network management software helps IT teams by automating time-consuming tasks, streamlining operations, and mitigating risk. It’s more important than ever to be able to remotely monitor and manage network infrastructure, and with Auvik, IT professionals have that essential visibility and control.
You want to work with a leadership team who are transparent and trustworthy. Our senior leaders have a vision for Auvik. They are experienced, knowledgeable, approachable, and consistently working hard to drive success, both for the company and the team of people who make it happen.
You want to work with a product customers love. People rave about what we’ve built—our latest NPS was 57 (phenomenal!). Our customers are smart, aspirational, and highly technical. It pays to get the details right.
You want regular opportunities for learning and growth. With ongoing feedback from leadership, you’ll find that Auvik encourages you to be your very best. Our onboarding process is thorough and informative because we want to make sure you’re prepared to have a great work experience. We also have programs designed to help you take the next steps you want for your career.
You want the flexibility to manage your work, your way. We’re a fully distributed team and we’re prepared to continue to support working from home (or the space you choose!). When we’re able, we’ll have Auvik hubs in Waterloo and Barcelona for you to leverage if needed. We trust you to get the job done where you feel most comfortable and effective.
What’s the job about?
As a software engineer at Auvik, you’ll be part of an agile team of coders, developing a network management service that monitors millions of devices, while solving big challenges for our customers. Drawing on your love of developing creative solutions, your can-do attitude, and your drive to do great work, you’ll help Auvik continue to build software our customers can rely on.
What will you be doing?
The industry is shifting towards cloud based systems and distributed work environments. We need senior software developers like yourself to level up on our product offerings. In this role, you will:
Focus on designing architectures for microservices that are consistent, scalable, high quality and tolerant to faults and failures.
Deploy and manage containerized applications using Kubernetes orchestration.
Design and implement protocols for communication in a highly scalable, distributed system.
Develop reliable and performant code for our collector deployed at tens of thousands of customer sites.
Apply AI-enabled techniques to solve complex engineering problems, using intelligent tooling, automation, and data-informed debugging to build scalable systems, improve reliability, and accelerate delivery across the stack.
Develop tooling using information from Netflow, Syslog, and other networking standards.
Help expand the depth and breadth of our solution based on your deep knowledge of networking devices and protocols.
Collaborate with engineering and product management to deliver software components to meet the needs of our customers.

Proven experience developing quality code and architectures preferably using C++ or Golang).
Background in designing and developing microservices.

Du lernst die Gründer Arne und Mirco persönlich kennen und hast auch die Möglichkeit mit dem Team zu quatschen. Shopware ist eine international führende Open‑Commerce‑Plattform für ambitionierte Unternehmen im digitalen Handel. In dieser Rolle arbeitest du an Tools wie der shopware-cli , die viele Entwickler täglich nutzen, um Shopware zu entwickeln, zu testen, bereitzustellen und zu betreiben. Diese Tools sind das Eingangstor zu unserem Open-Source-Ökosystem – und ihre Developer Experience prägt unmittelbar, wie Entwickler Shopware wahrnehmen.
Du hast klare Vorstellungen davon, wie sich eine gute CLI verhalten sollte? Du hast schon mit gh oder anderen CLI-Tools gearbeitet, die deinen Alltag deutlich einfacher gemacht haben, und dir dabei gedacht: „Genau so sollte sich das anfühlen“? Dann könnte diese Rolle genau das Richtige für dich sein.

Als Software Engineer im Developer Experience (DX) Tooling Team arbeitest du an den Tools und technischen Grundlagen, mit denen Entwickler Shopware entwickeln, erweitern, testen und betreiben. Mit deinen Beiträgen gestaltest du unmittelbar mit, wie angenehm, effizient und zuverlässig die Entwicklung auf unserer Plattform ist.
Diese Position kann vor Ort, hybrid oder vollständig remote innerhalb Deutschlands oder in bestimmten europäischen Ländern, in denen wir registriert sind, besetzt werden. Dein Arbeitsort wird im Voraus abgestimmt und bildet die Grundlage deines Arbeitsvertrags .
Du gestaltest Developer Workflows ganzheitlich – vom lokalen Setup über CI/CD und Deployment bis hin zum laufenden Betrieb. Dabei beschäftigst du dich unter anderem mit Containerisierung, Cloud-Native-Praktiken, GitOps und Telemetrie, mit der wir überprüfen können, ob das, was wir entwickeln, auch tatsächlich funktioniert.

Zunehmend bedeutet das auch, Tools so zu entwickeln, dass sie nicht nur für Menschen im Terminal, sondern ebenso für AI Agents und CI-Pipelines geeignet sind. Gleichzeitig nutzen wir selbst AI-Tools, um unsere Lösungen schneller und effizienter zu entwickeln und zu warten.
Du entwickelst die Grundlagen unseres Open-Source-Ökosystems weiter – von der CLI über APIs bis hin zu den Tools und Integrationen, die sie umgeben.
Du setzt hohe Standards für Codequalität. Gut getestet, sauber strukturiert und so entwickelt, dass der Code langfristig wartbar ist – nicht nur schnell ausgeliefert. Dazu gehören für uns auch klare Konventionen und Tooling, die dafür sorgen, dass diese Standards mit wachsendem Team und Codebestand erhalten bleiben.
Du bringst dich aktiv in unsere Open-Source-Community ein. Du reviewst Contributions, verbesserst Dokumentationen und stehst im Austausch mit den Entwickler, die deine Tools täglich nutzen.
Du verbindest Teams und Perspektiven. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Core-, SaaS/PaaS-, Documentation- und Community-Teams zusammen, damit unser Tooling die tatsächlichen Bedürfnisse unserer Developer Community widerspiegelt.

Erfahrung mit Go ist ideal. Eines der Tools, auf das wir aktuell einen besonderen Fokus legen, basiert auf Go. Du musst kein Go-Experte bzw. keine Go-Expertin sein – wichtiger sind deine Motivation und deine Fähigkeit, dich schnell in neue Technologien einzuarbeiten.
PHP-Kenntnisse, idealerweise mit Symfony, sind ein starkes Plus. Teile unseres Toolings, beispielsweise Deployment-Helfer, basieren direkt auf PHP. Gleichzeitig hilft dir dieses Wissen dabei, das Shopware-Ökosystem, für das unsere CLI entwickelt wird, noch besser zu verstehen.
Du begeisterst dich wirklich für Developer Tools und hast Empathie für die Menschen, die sie verwenden. Vielleicht hast du bereits an Projekten mit klarem DX-Fokus gearbeitet, eigene Side Projects entwickelt, zu CLIs oder Developer Tooling beigetragen – Open Source oder anderweitig – oder du bist einfach die Person im Team, die ein Issue erstellt, wenn ein Workflow unnötig umständlich ist.
Du hast praktische Erfahrung darin, Developer Experience zu verbessern , beispielsweise durch CLI-Tooling, Automatisierung, APIs, Scaffolding oder die Optimierung von Entwicklungsworkflows.
Automatisierte Tests und CI-Workflows gehören für dich zum Engineering-Alltag. Du hast ein gutes Gespür dafür, wie sich Tools nahtlos in bestehende Developer-Ökosysteme integrieren lassen.
Du nutzt AI-gestützte Entwicklungsworkflows aktiv , zum Beispiel beim Coding, bei Dokumentation oder Automatisierung. Gleichzeitig setzt du dich kritisch damit auseinander, wo AI Engineering tatsächlich effizienter macht – und wo nicht. Begriffe wie MCP oder AI Skills sind dir nicht fremd.

Swiss Medical Network convainc par la haute qualité de ses prestations, un environnement de travail agréable et une équipe de direction expérimentée à l'esprit entrepreneurial. Le réseau exploite actuellement 21 cliniques et hôpitaux dans toute la Suisse et est présent dans les trois principales régions linguistiques.
Description du poste
En tant que Fullstack Developer (AI \& Digital Health), vous jouez un rôle moteur dans la transformation numérique de nos cliniques. Vous concevez et développez des solutions logicielles innovantes assistées par l'IA, qui améliorent le parcours du patient tout en soulageant le personnel médical. Vous agissez comme un pont technique entre les exigences médicales et les technologies de pointe, garantissant que nos applications de santé numériques sont sécurisées, évolutives et conviviales.

Votre domaine d'activité
Développement \& Architecture de solutions : Conception et implémentation d'applications web Fullstack évolutives (Frontend \& Backend) pour un usage clinique et administratif.
Intégration de l'IA : Développement et intégration de modèles d'apprentissage automatique (Machine Learning), de LLM (Large Language Models) et de services d'IA déterministes (explainable AI) dans des applications existantes et nouvelles pour soutenir les processus diagnostiques ou administratifs.
Données \& Interfaces : Connexion des applications aux systèmes primaires cliniques (KIS/HIS/DPI) en utilisant des standards d'interopérabilité modernes (ex. FHIR, HL7\) et garantie d'un échange de données fluide.
Security by Design : Garantie des standards de sécurité les plus élevés et de la conformité à la protection des données (LPD/RGPD) lors du traitement des données sensibles des patients, en étroite coordination avec le délégué à la protection des données.
DevOps \& Cloud : Mise en place et maintenance de pipelines CI/CD ainsi que gestion de l'infrastructure Cloud pour l'exploitation des solutions d'IA.
Prototyping : Développement rapide de preuves de concept (PoC) pour évaluer le potentiel des nouvelles technologies d'IA pour le quotidien clinique et les rendre tangibles.
Collaboration : Étroite coopération avec les Data Scientists, les médecins et le personnel soignant afin de créer des solutions centrées sur l'utilisateur ("User Centricity").
Votre profil
Formation : Diplôme universitaire en informatique, ingénierie logicielle ou qualification comparable avec un fort accent sur les technologies web modernes.
Compétences en développement : Expérience approfondie dans les frameworks Backend (ex. Python, , Java) et Frontend (ex. React, Angular, modernes, idéalement sur la Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Looker). Des connaissances en Python sont privilégiées en raison de l'orientation IA.
Expertise en IA : Expérience pratique dans l'intégration de composants IA/ML (ex. API OpenAI, LangChain, Hugging Face, TensorFlow) dans des environnements logiciels productifs.
Secteur de la santé : Une expérience avec les normes du secteur de la santé (FHIR, HL7, DICOM) est un avantage, mais pas obligatoire si vous êtes prêt à vous y former. Une expérience avec le "Software as Medical Device" et les processus de certification correspondants constitue un atout majeur.
Méthode de travail : Un mode de travail autonome, agile (Scrum/Kanban) et orienté solutions. Vous avez une mentalité "Can\-Do" et prenez plaisir à résoudre des problèmes complexes par le code.
Personnalité : Esprit d'innovation couplé à une conscience de la qualité. Vous savez rendre des sujets techniques compréhensibles pour des interlocuteurs non techniques.
Langues : De langue maternelle allemande avec un niveau courant/négociation en français (ou inversement) ; de bonnes connaissances en anglais sont requises pour la collaboration au sein de nos équipes linguistiques régionales.
Tech\-Stack : Des connaissances en technologies de conteneurisation (Docker, Kubernetes), plateformes Cloud (Azure/GCP) et gestion de versions (Git) sont prérequis.
Informations supplémentaires
Notre offre
Innovation : Nous vous offrons la possibilité de travailler à la pointe de l'innovation médicale et de développer des solutions d'IA qui apportent une véritable plus\-value à la vie des patients.
Création : Vous bénéficiez d'une grande marge de manœuvre technique dans un environnement dynamique qui favorise les circuits de décision courts et la pensée entrepreneuriale.
Environnement : Un climat de travail inspirant au sein d'une équipe interdisciplinaire composée de médecins et de spécialistes IT, un package salarial attractif ainsi que des prestations sociales progressistes vous attendent.
Développement : Réjouissez\-vous de projets passionnants avec les dernières technologies et une grande responsabilité personnelle au sein d'un groupe de cliniques en pleine croissance.

Create, review, and evolve conda recipes, build tooling, and release processes that keep compiled packages reliable at scale.
Partner with our pure Python wheels and distribution teams so both efforts stay in step as automation and infrastructure needs grow.
Mentor engineers on architecture, debugging, and packaging practices, sharing context as you go.
Lead postmortems, capacity planning, and incident response for build and distribution infrastructure.
Advise technical leadership on project scoping and delivery trade offs, bringing full context before recommending a path.
Comfortable engaging with AI assisted development tools, such as Claude Code, as appropriate, including reviewing and validating AI generated code before it ships.

As a Software Engineer on the AWS Emulator team, you’ll help expand and harden LocalStack ’s AWS emulator by taking ownership of individual services and making them behave as closely as possible to real AWS.
The challenge is genuinely unusual: you’ll reimplement cloud services that you can only observe from the outside. Making a service “work” is one thing; matching AWS behaviour — including edge cases and undocumented details — is a very different engineering problem.
We’re looking for someone who learns quickly, enjoys tackling unfamiliar problems, and can turn incomplete information into working solutions. You’ll have end-to-end ownership of your services, from investigating how they behave and deciding what needs to be built through implementation, testing, and ongoing improvements.
AI is a core part of how the team works. You’ll use modern AI coding and agentic tools to make development more efficient while maintaining the quality and reliability expected by LocalStack users. The role offers a clear path to broader service ownership and technical leadership as your scope grows.
✅ What you will be working on/responsible for
Internalize services off moto. Independently take AWS services from moto-backed to fully first-party implementations, owning store design for persistence, full API operation coverage, and conformance to LocalStack conventions rather than transplanted moto code. Measured by services shipped and their size.
Close parity gaps in owned services. Raise snapshot-test coverage against real AWS for the documented API surface for owned services, with a measurable reduction in parity defects reported from the field.
Own services end-to-end after they ship. Act as first responder for their services: customer-reported parity bugs triaged and turned around within 5 days median, including those that surface through Terraform and CDK rather than direct API calls.
Raise the team's testing floor. Contribute reusable test infrastructure (conformance harnesses, snapshot tooling, fixtures) that other engineers adopt for services they do not own.
Grow visibly in scope. By month 12, be trusted to scope and sequence an internalization independently, from API-documentation analysis through to shipped provider, without needing the plan handed to them.

s.h: ✅ Experience we expect you to bring to the role
s.t:
3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong engineering fundamentals. We’re language-agnostic — prior Python experience is not required.
Experience working from a written specification against a system you cannot see inside, such as public APIs, protocols, wire formats, parsers, compilers, SDKs, emulators, or reverse-engineering projects.
A strong testing mindset — you use tests as a tool for understanding and designing systems, not just for checking finished code.
Hands-on experience with AI coding and agentic development tools. We’re looking for more than basic Copilot usage: you should have used these tools substantially to build and ship real software and understand both their strengths and limitations.
Fast learning and strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to quickly understand unfamiliar systems and work effectively with incomplete information.
Strong Plus
Open-source contribution experience, particularly sustained involvement in an existing project.
Experience working with AWS, at either application or platform level.
Experience with distributed systems, storage, or protocol conformance.

Deep AWS expertise.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code, such as Terraform, CDK, or Pulumi.
Experience with Kubernetes and microservices architecture.

The Data Application Developer designs, builds, deploys, and supports full-stack enterprise applications that use Databricks as the core data, analytics, AI, and workflow execution platform.

The role also integrates these applications with enterprise systems such as SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP Business One, Salesforce, Power BI, Azure services, and other business platforms where application workflows require trusted data, analytics, write-back, automation, or process execution.

The person must be able to work from business requirements through UI/UX, application logic, Databricks integration, security, deployment, testing, adoption, support, and iterative enhancement. This role is also responsible for helping hire, coordinate, and manage additional offshore application development support resources to scale capability and delivery.

Design build, deploy, and support end-to-end enterprise applications on Databricks and Azure, including frontend UX, backend logic, data access, APIs, workflow triggers, monitoring, and release management.
· Build Databricks-native or Databricks-integrated applications using Unity Catalog-governed data, Databricks SQL, dashboards, model outputs, Lakeflow Jobs, notebooks, APIs, and AI services.
· Develop business applications for reporting, forecasting, planning, operational workflows, approvals, exception handling, data quality remediation, and process automation.
· Create user interfaces for planning inputs, forecast overrides, commentary, scenarios, approvals, business rules, control checks, and operational decision support.

· Develop reusable components, templates, documentation, deployment patterns, and standards for enterprise Databricks application delivery.
· Support production applications through troubleshooting, performance tuning, enhancement intake, defect resolution, usage monitoring, release management, and adoption improvements.
· Build and manage offshore application development support, including work intake, technical direction, delivery standards, code review, backlog execution, quality control, and production support
Example Application Domains

The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.
n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.
Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:
Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders
Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects
Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation
That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register .
We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.
🎯 Your main goal will be to keep n8n operating as an AI-native engineering organization where agents are embedded across the development cycle; helping teams plan, build, test, review, learn, and improve.
You’ll do this by maintaining and evolving the platform foundations, tools, guardrails, and team processes that make agentic development safe, measurable, and sustainable. Working with Developer Platform, Security, AI/Agents, Architecture, and product engineering teams, you’ll help teams continuously adopt what works from frontier AI and make success visible through faster feedback loops, better quality, stronger resilience, and more learning from what we ship:

s.h: BUILD THE PAVED ROAD FOR AGENTIC DEVELOPMENT
s.t:
Define safe task categories for autonomous agents, including what they can attempt, what they should never touch, and where additional review is required.
Design and implement isolated execution environments where agents can work without exposing secrets or accessing sensitive systems unnecessarily.
Build pilot workflows that allow selected Linear issues to be picked up by agents, tested, and converted into useful draft PRs.

Create and maintain repo instructions, agent playbooks, ownership metadata, coding guidelines, and documentation that improve agent performance.
Continuously improve developer workflows, repo structure, testability, and documentation based on where agents succeed, fail, or create reviewer friction.
Partner with Architecture and senior engineers to define boundaries, dependencies, and areas where agents need more context or tighter constraints.

Integrate agentic workflows with Linear, GitHub, CI, test infrastructure, and developer review processes.
Design PR evidence templates that help reviewers understand what changed, why, what tests ran, what risks remain, and where human judgment is needed.
Partner with Security, AI/Agents, Developer Platform, and product engineering teams to define guardrails for sensitive areas like auth, billing, permissions, and data handling.

Create benchmarks from real historical engineering tasks to evaluate agent output quality, failure modes, test pass rates, review burden, and production risk.
Define quality signals and adoption metrics such as draft PR usefulness rate, reviewer acceptance rate, CI pass rate, rework rate, and developer satisfaction.
Use data and feedback from pilot teams to improve agent workflows, reduce unsafe attempts, and build trust across engineering.

Must-haves
🧠 Autonomous coding agents: You have experience with autonomous coding agents, AI coding platforms, agent orchestration systems, or internal AI developer tooling.
🤖 Agentic development experience: You have practical experience building, deploying, or operating AI-assisted or agentic software development workflows that work with developers not besides them.
🛠️ Strong engineering foundations: You have a strong software engineering background, ideally in platform engineering, developer experience, infrastructure, tooling, CI/CD, or engineering productivity.
🧭 Ambiguity leadership: You’re comfortable leading a first-of-a-kind technical initiative from problem definition through pilot, adoption, measurement, and iteration.
🔁 Modern engineering workflows: You deeply understand GitHub, CI, testing strategies, code review, monorepos, issue tracking, developer environments, and release risk.
🔐 Safety-first judgment: You have strong judgment around permissions, secrets, sandboxing, sensitive code paths, and human-in-the-loop review.
📊 Measurable systems thinking: You know how to design benchmarks, quality signals, failure-mode tracking, and adoption metrics.
✍️ Clear written communication: You’re strong at writing repo instructions, playbooks, PR evidence templates, technical proposals, and alignment documents.
🤝 Cross-functional influence: You have credibility with senior engineers and can influence across Platform, Product Engineering, AI, Security, and Architecture without formal authority.
Nice-to-haves
📦 TypeScript monorepos: You have worked in a large TypeScript, Node.js, or JavaScript monorepo.
⚙️ Developer platforms: You have experience with GitHub Actions, Linear, automated testing infrastructure, preview environments, or internal developer platforms.
🛡️ Security-aware platform engineering: You have worked on sandboxing, secrets management, least-privilege access, or sensitive code ownership.
📏 AI evaluation: You have created evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, or quality metrics for AI-generated code or automation systems.
🌍 Open-source communities: You have experience contributing to open-source or source-available projects with active developer communities.
🏢 B2B SaaS context: You understand environments where reliability, permissions, data handling, and customer trust are central.
🔗 Workflow automation: You’re familiar with workflow automation, integration platforms, AI orchestration, or developer-facing products.

At n8n, you’ll help define how autonomous AI agents become a trusted part of engineering inside one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI-native infrastructure companies. Your work will shape the platform foundations, safety model, evaluation framework, and developer workflows that determine whether agents can contribute meaningfully to production engineering without lowering the quality bar.
You’ll join a remote-first team with high autonomy, high visibility, and a strong builder mindset. Because this is a first-of-a-kind role, you’ll have the opportunity to set direction, influence engineering culture, and create learnings that may inform both internal engineering productivity and n8n’s external product thinking.
Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?
Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

Dashlane’s mission is to deliver the credential security every business and employee needs to thrive. This role is a strong fit for an engineer who has already built security-relevant product features in a SaaS environment, understands application security fundamentals, and can contribute pragmatically to secure, scalable backend systems.

You will be based in Paris, with English as your working language. At Dashlane, we embrace a hybrid culture that combines the best of both worlds: the creativity and energy of in-person collaboration with the flexibility of remote work.

Our model is designed to strengthen team connections while supporting individual productivity and work-life balance. To maximize collaboration, we come together in the office on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, while Wednesdays and Fridays offer more flexibility for focused work.

Research, design, implement, and maintain backend services that support user-protection features across B2B and B2C products.

Work closely with the Product team and the Security team to assess new opportunities, translate security requirements and risk assessments into effective product features.

### Nous recrutons ! ###
Sonceboz est une entreprise suisse leader dans la conception et la fabrication de systèmes mécatroniques d-entrainement. Nous incarnons la mécatronique sur les marchés, notamment grâce à notre signature : « From Mind to Motion ».
Vous avez dit mécatronique ? Une solution mécatronique combine de la mécanique, de l-électronique et de l-informatique. Nos solutions, qui reposent sur des technologies électromagnétiques sans contact, reçoivent un signal électrique et le transforment en un mouvement mécanique. Elles se déclinent en moteurs pas-à-pas ou brushless DC, en capteurs magnétiques, réducteurs mécaniques, logiciel et électroniques de commande.
Nous nous engageons à fournir à nos clients des solutions d-une qualité et d-une fiabilité irréprochables. C-est ce qui fait notre renommée dans le monde entier, et nous y travaillons jour après jour.
### Votre mission ###
Au sein d-une équipe projet pluridisciplinaire, vous contribuez au développement de solutions mécatroniques innovantes, de la conception jusqu-à la validation produit.

*
* Concevez et développez des actionneurs et systèmes mécatroniques en appliquant les principes de Design to Cost et Design for Six Sigma.
*
* Réalisez les études de conception, calculs et simulations afin de valider les choix techniques.
*
* Élaborez les modèles CAO, les plans de définition, les chaînes de cotes fonctionnelles et assurez la montabilité des produits.
*
* Assurer la réalisation et le suivi des prototypes.
*
* Réalisez les tests préliminaires et analysez les résultats afin de garantir l-atteinte des performances attendues.
*
* Collaborez avec les fournisseurs internes et externes pour définir et optimiser les solutions techniques et industrielles.
*
* Constituez et maintenez le Design Justification File (DJF) en garantissant la traçabilité des choix de conception.
*
* Participez aux AMDEC Produit et contribuez à l-identification et à la maîtrise des risques.
*
* Contribuez aux analyses de défauts, à la résolution de problèmes et à la définition des plans d-actions techniques associés.
*
### Vos compétences ###
*
* Excellente maîtrise de la CAO 3D/2D, de la mise en plan, des chaînes de cotes et des tolérances fonctionnelles.
*
* Solides compétences en simulation numérique (calculs mécaniques, analyses multiphysiques) permettant d-orienter et de valider les choix de conception.
*
* Bonne connaissance des procédés de fabrication, notamment de l-usinage, et des contraintes d-industrialisation.
*
* Expérience du développement, du suivi et de la validation de prototypes, en collaboration avec les fournisseurs et les équipes projet.
*
* Capacité à intervenir sur le terrain lors des montages et essais afin d-assurer la convergence technique des solutions développées.
*
* Capacité à évoluer dans un environnement dynamique nécessitant réactivité, polyvalence et prise de décision technique.
*
### Votre parcours ###
*
* Formation d-ingénieur en mécanique, mécatronique ou équivalent.
*
* Expérience confirmée en développement de produits mécaniques, idéalement dans un environnement industriel exigeant.
